messages.content: The depth averages in this workbook look wrong to me but I cannot see why. Can you check it?

segments.delta: Three sheets in the file they sent: species, monthly readings, and a notes tab. The readings tab is the one with the problem — the TOTAL row is inside the data range, so anything that reads the sheet picks it up as a thirteenth month.
Found it — the TOTAL row on the Readings sheet sits inside the data range, so every average you computed was pulled toward it. Cleaned version attached, same three sheets.
The Species sheet is unchanged. Readings now stops at December, and I moved the total out to its own row below a blank. Write-up of what changed and why the old averages were off:
